# Third-party motion sources

This local pack adapts selected animation code from:

- Onda — Copyright (c) 2026 Rodrigo Botelho. MIT License.
- RenderComp free-remotion-templates — Copyright (c) 2026 Trimora Inc. MIT License.

The full, unmodified licenses are retained at `onda/LICENSE` and `rendercomp/LICENSE`.
Original selected files, their exact source commits, original URLs, and SHA-256
digests are listed in `manifest.json`. Keep these notices with distributions.

The runtime adaptations in `src/motion/` change typography, geometry, timing,
parameter handling, theme integration, and rendering composition for Fish Video
Workbench. They do not install the complete upstream projects or include their
branding, websites, fonts, photos, audio, or other external assets. Upstream README
files are retained as provenance, not instructions for this workspace.
